name: list2DF
title: Build a data frame from a list

origin.description: Every column must have the same length. There is no recycling.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A dict of columns. Default empty.

arguments.name: nrow
arguments.text: Row count used when x is empty.

origin.details: An empty list uses nrow. Unequal lengths raise an error.
